name: GetActiveExcelWorksheet
label: Get Active Excel Worksheet
description: Retrieves the name and index of the currently active worksheet in a given Excel workbook.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook object from which to retrieve the active worksheet.

fields.name: SheetName
fields.label: Sheet Name
fields.description: Returns the name of the currently active worksheet.

fields.name: SheetIndex
fields.label: Sheet Index
fields.description: Returns the index of the currently active worksheet.
